description: Pre-industrial control simulation with no fire emissions. In models that use prescribed fire emissions (known as open biomass burning emissions in the forcings), both burned area in the model code and prescribed fire aerosol emissions in the forcing dataset should be set to zero. In models with interactive fire modules, set burned area to zero so that fire emissions are therefore diagnosed as zero.
branch_information: Branch from `piControl-spinup` at a time of your choosing
